payload.purpose_context: Epic #287 moved open-packs onto a charter release pin and a pack-check gate. This mission closes the remaining follow-ups: it records the accepted stray-file round-trip gap (#331), fixes the derived-manifest mirror's edge cases (#262), adds a warn-only attestation check and drops the write token from the step that re-derives the packs on a release bump (#310), anchors the self-binding vocabulary patterns (#304), and refreshes the epic and roadmap state.
payload.purpose_tldr: Finish the charter release-pin work: settle the stray-file gap, close the manifest-mirror edge cases, and harden the release bump.

reason: Review passed (claude::reviewer-renata). Both tests non-vacuous: a reviewer-applied option-2 override (drop round_trip_red naming a file_not_held file) turns JudgeTheSet and RealPackCheck red; reverted. RealPackCheck passes against the pinned rc.3 jar on Java 25 and runs in the Charter service validation job (setup-java 25, PACK_CHECK_JAR set, set -e); elsewhere it is a counted skip. It fails loudly on the pin bump that brings charter#631 (exit 0 != 1). Docstring matches the #331 option-3 ruling. Only owned files touched; no downgrade of round_trip_red (C-001). Non-blocking nits: (a) the real-jar assertIn('notes.txt') is also met by the ::notice line, not only the round_trip_red line; (b) the notes.md half does not assert the file_not_held notice.
